mapper.select: select id, api_interval_seconds, thread_count, detection_frequency_minutes, notify_email, updated_at from pkg_pack_stat_detect_config order by id asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pkg_pack_stat_detect_config (api_interval_seconds, thread_count, detection_frequency_minutes, notify_email, updated_at) values (#{apiIntervalSeconds}, #{threadCount}, #{detectionFrequencyMinutes}, #{notifyEmail}, #{updatedAt})
